dataset.name: DISARM 1.7.0 official SQLite core matrix
dataset.language_layer: Authored interface, guide and text reports are RU/KK/EN. Official DISARM records use only a reviewed dictionary for the selected language or their complete source wording; canonical identifiers and source names remain in technical exports.

interpretation_rules: Technique frequency in this corpus is not a probability, prevalence estimate or risk score.
A technique-to-countermeasure relationship expresses structural applicability, not proven effectiveness in a specific context.
Analyst-entered priority values are local browser state and are not source data.
DISARM 2.0 Observations and Assessments are separate models and are not merged into the 1.7 matrix.
known_limits: The full source corpus has not been manually literary-translated into Russian.
Two upstream references to absent technique T0005 are intentionally excluded from the local matrix.
This public explorer does not determine legal, ethical or operational suitability of a countermeasure.
